ops.body:
- **T? [owner] Explore: a checklist that holds a retired kind is read again on entry** (2026-11-26)
  Area: explore. Seen: poi-hide-from-card audit 2 and the diff review's F9 (`src/lib/discovery/refinements.ts` `isKindHidden`'s `RETIRED[kind].now.every`, `src/lib/explore/placeCard.ts` `cardKinds`); the steward's S2 at the plan. Rests on: E4 ("a build change clears it, so areas are read again", `.claude/rules/explore-and-discovery.md`) and HK9 ("a reader who had the shared switch off keeps both off"), decision 0254.
  Since p12 (G12) clock towers and water towers are two kinds. A checklist item read before the split keeps the kind `towers` until its area is read again (a new tile build, or its archive block's places changing, `archiveStale`, PP13), and no store holds a place's class to tell which tower it is (the web leaves `classes` out of the stored place, SQLite's `place` has no column). Meanwhile such a tower reads as Buildings and structures alone on its card and sheet, and stays on the map with Water towers off until both tower switches are; 1,288 of the archive's 1,309 towers are water towers (the live places-us archive, 20261123.40). Hiding it when either switch is off (`.some`) would hide the clock towers too.
  Recommended: an area whose checklist items hold a retired kind (`RETIRED`, `discovery/subtypes.ts`) counts as stale on entry, beside `archiveStale`, so it is read again on the next walk there and its towers take their own kinds; no migration, nothing stored anew; amends E4's "rebuilt when its build is old". /vision: no surface (what the switches already promise, on time).
  Precedent: none found (a cache made stale by a change of its own vocabulary is the app's own case; the atlas and the landing do it by `PRESENCE_CODE`).
  Otherwise: leave it; it heals at the next tile build or block change.

- [loop] Low, engineering: What I'm into's settings copy can take back a switch it just saved (poi-hide-from-card diff review F13, Nov 26). `useExploreSettings` (`src/lib/explore/useExploreSettings.ts` l.17, l.24-29) sets its state, saves, and also takes every `onSettings` it hears, its own echo included, so two quick switches can see the first save's echo land after the second change and draw the older choices (main's, on the page; reachable from a place card's kinds sheet since G12). Fix: ignore its own echo (a sequence number on each save, or compare with the last saved), with a test "What I'm into's copy keeps the latest of two quick switches" over `withKind` and a fake `onSettings`.

An unfound place's card on the walk names its kind under the name and has More (48), opening "Show on the map": its kind and subtype as What I'm into's own switches, acting at once on the map behind, a subtype dimmed while its kind is off, then "What I’m into ›" at that kind with Back reading "Walk". Clock towers and Water towers are two switches (`PRESENCE_CODE` p12; a stored shared switch off keeps both off; the landing keeps its p11 rows, the atlas re-derives).
